verdict.rationale: Airwallex's own spend-management docs show bills are routed for approval and that approvers review flagged expenses, so a basic approval workflow exists. Nothing in the evidence shows configurable multi-step chains (manager, budget owner, finance), delegation, or escalation when approvers stall. missing for 10: multi-step/sequential approval chain configuration, role-based approver steps (manager/budget owner/finance), delegation of approval authority, escalation or reminders for stalled approvals, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can build multi-step approval chains — manager, budget owner, finance — with delegation and escalation when approvers sit on requests

citations.quote: Simply attach your bill, then watch AI fill out accounting fields before routing it for approval.
Upload, manage, approve, and pay Canadian and international bills from one platform
Duplicates and other common issues are caught early, so approvers focus only on what truly needs review.
